claims.text: PETRONAS reported revenue of RM68.1 billion for the first half of 2026, an increase of RM8.1 billion or 14% compared to the same period in 2025.
PETRONAS reported profit after tax (PAT) of RM16.7 billion for the first half of 2026, up RM6.3 billion from RM10.4 billion in 1H 2025.
PETRONAS reported capital investments of RM5.4 billion for the first half of 2026, comparable to RM5.4 billion in 1H 2025.
PETRONAS reported Malaysia average sales gas volume of 3,111 mmscfd and gross LNG sales volume of 20.29 million tonnes for 1H 2026, both higher than the prior year.
PETRONAS reports in Malaysian Ringgit (MYR), with fiscal year ending 31 December, and uses millions as units.
PTT Global Chemical (GC) reports in Thai Baht (THB), with fiscal year ending 31 December, and uses millions as units.
GC uses adjusted EBITDA as a key measure, defined as EBITDA excluding stock gain/(loss), NRV, gain/(loss) from commodity hedging, and extra items.
GC's Upstream Business reported an adjusted EBITDA of THB 7,398 million in 2025, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 3%.
GC's petroleum and petrochemical product sales volumes in 2025 were 58.2 million barrels and 4.9 million tons, respectively, affected by planned maintenance shutdowns.
GC's performance in 2025 was impacted by planned maintenance shutdowns in Olefins Plant 2/1, Refinery, and Aromatics 2, and by declining crude oil prices and product spreads.
Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) reports in Indian Rupees (INR), with fiscal year ending 31 March, and uses crore as units.
RIL's retail business registered gross revenue of ₹90,408 crore for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, up 7.4% year-on-year.
RIL's retail EBITDA from operations was ₹5,935 crore for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, down 1.8% year-on-year, with an EBITDA margin from operations of 7.4%.
RIL's retail EBITDA was ₹6,309 crore for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, down 1.1% year-on-year, with an EBITDA margin of 7.9%.
RIL's retail margin moderation of 80 basis points in 1Q FY27 reflects growing contribution of Digital Commerce and associated infrastructure investments increasing fixed cost.

RIL's JioStar business reported revenue from operations of ₹10,946 crore in 1Q FY27, up 14% year-on-year, and EBITDA from operations of ₹933 crore, up 30.7% year-on-year, with an EBITDA margin of 9.6%.
RIL's Oil to Chemicals (O2C) segment revenue increased by 30.4% year-on-year in 1Q FY27, driven by sharp increase in crude prices partially offset by lower production meant for sale.
RIL's Oil and Gas segment revenue increased by 3.2% year-on-year in 1Q FY27, aided by higher realization on KG D6 oil/condensate and favourable exchange rate movement.
RIL's capital expenditure for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 was ₹38,682 crore, with continued progress on projects in O2C and New Energy business, and investment in consumer business infrastructure.

There are differences in reporting currency and fiscal year among the groups: PETRONAS reports in MYR with fiscal year ending 31 December, GC in THB with fiscal year ending 31 December, and RIL in INR with fiscal year ending 31 March.
GC's reporting for 1H 2026 is not available; the latest available figures are for the year ended 31 December 2025.
RIL's reporting for 1H 2026 is available only for the quarter ended 30 June 2026; no half-year consolidated figures are provided in the evidence.

gaps.subject: GC financial and operational performance for 1H 2026
gaps.detail: No interim or half-year figures for 2026 are available; only full-year 2025 data is reported.

gaps.subject: RIL consolidated financial and operational performance for 1H 2026
gaps.detail: Only quarterly figures for Q1 FY27 (ended 30 June 2026) are available; no half-year summary is reported in the evidence.

coverage_note: PETRONAS provides full half-year figures for 1H 2026. GC only reports full-year 2025 data; no 1H 2026 interim results are available. RIL provides quarterly figures for Q1 FY27 (ended 30 June 2026), but no consolidated half-year summary. Comparability is limited by differences in reporting currency, fiscal year, and available periods.
